PHASE.NAME: RTK Shell-Aware Rewrite Registry
PHASE.GOAL: Extend Synapse hook rewriting from single commands to safe RTK-style shell command sequences so agent shell hooks can proxy more token-heavy commands automatically.

STEPS.step-1: Implemented quote-aware rewrite for safe command chains joined by &&, ||, and ; while preserving unknown segments.
STEPS.step-2: Kept OpenCode hook delegation unchanged and verified it benefits from the expanded syn rewrite behavior.
STEPS.step-3: Added regression coverage for compound rewrite output and unsupported unsafe shell constructs.
